department: School of Electrical, Computer and Energy Engineering

deadline.value: Preference for complete applications by December 31, 2026 (fall); results by March 1. Later applications are still considered.
deadline.quote: Preference is given to complete School of Electrical, Computer and Energy Engineering graduate applications received by December 31. Admission results should be available by March 1.

gre_general.value: The Fulton Schools require the GRE for PhD programs; if your master's is not from a U.S. ABET-accredited school you need GRE Quant 156 or higher. At-home GRE not accepted.
gre_general.quote: GRE is required for PHD programs.

also.quote: A student whose master's degree is not from a U.S. ABET-accredited institution must score 156 or higher on the quantitative section of the GRE General Test.

supervisor.value: The school advises finding a PhD advisor with a funded project; RAs come from individual faculty.
supervisor.quote: Look for an advisor who has a funded project in need of a student.

funding.value: Only a limited number of students get written funding offers before entry; others must fund themselves.
funding.quote: A limited number of students receive written offers of financial aid prior to entering the program. Students who elect to enter the program without a written commitment of financial aid are responsible for providing their own financial support.

entry_route.value: A master's degree is usually needed; direct doctoral admission is available for graduates of ABET-accredited programs.
entry_route.quote: A student usually must hold a master's degree before being admitted to the doctoral program. Direct doctoral admission is available for students graduating from an ABET-accredite

gre_subject.value: There is no GRE Subject test for this field; nothing stated.

notes: TA applicants need TOEFL speaking 26 or SPEAK 50. Minimum GPA 3.50 in graduate coursework. A separate Computer Engineering PhD (December 31 fall deadline per SCAI) is also offered.
name: Electrical Engineering PhD
